stem: When the expression \(4x^{2} - 3(2x - 7) + x\) is simplified, what is the coefficient of \(x\)?
solution: Combine the \(x\)-terms: \(-6x + x = -5x\). The expression is \(4x^{2} - 5x + 21\), so the coefficient of \(x\) is \(-5\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
c = Poly(expand(4*x**2 - 3*(2*x - 7) + x), x).coeff_monomial(x)
assert c == -5
assert [Rational(v) for v in spr_answers] == [c]
